the_turn: Slide 6. Exact, roughly and over become a stop, a cleaved half and an open channel side by side, and the reader understands why the November boat on 1 had no far end.

weakest_frames.problem: The largest object was a faceted kit person's head; the nineteen wafers rendered flat black.
weakest_frames.repair_made: The figure became a silhouette in the flow pass, then the panel named it twice, so frame 8 was recomposed as one wafer cut into a grid of dies on the bench.

weakest_frames.problem: The vicinal surface read as grooved asphalt and the island was cropped off the left edge.
weakest_frames.repair_made: Steps raised from 16 to 38, the island pulled into frame; after the panel, the terraces were cut inside one wafer's disc on the bench.

weakest_frames.problem: Lubbock County under a tenth of the frame; label outside the county.
weakest_frames.repair_made: Re-projected at zoom 12.2 so the county spans 434 px, label inside in black ink.

weakest_frames.problem: The cleaved half read as a translucent blade.
weakest_frames.repair_made: A camera swing was tried and hid the half wafer, so it was reverted.

weakest_frames.problem: The tray rendered mid grey; the discs read as buttons.
weakest_frames.repair_made: Near black anodised tray, dusk_gold rims on November's discs.

cross_frame.problem: One set and camera family on four frames; 1 and 3 repeated.
cross_frame.repair_made: Frame 3 re-shot from a high three quarter view.

cross_frame.problem: Every relief sits under a flat black type band with a hard seam.
cross_frame.repair_made: Not repaired this run. Named for the machine queue.
